verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a travel-and-expense SaaS, but the evidence shows no documented bulk export, no open-format downloads and no account-exit or offboarding process. The expense API retrieval endpoints and the MCP query tools are developer building blocks for pulling some data out. They are not a first-party export-everything-and-leave capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
